public_hook: Some people don't share blankets. They win them.
reader_identity_mirror: Every couple with one blanket and two temperature settings can tag themselves.

aachu_specific_proof: She says thand lag rahi hai, starts with her side, then the middle, then his corner too.
zuv_active_role: He notices, stays fond, tucks her in first, and makes the bedtime chaos safe instead of shaming it.
earned_ending: Love is one bed, two climates.
send_save_reason: The final line is easy to send to the blanket-stealer or the cold-side partner.
